name: comfypilot
description: MCP server for ComfyUI v0.20 through v0.31.1+. 96 tools, strict validation, resilient jobs/events, Desktop control, generic artifacts, worker visibility, 11 model families + 5 family-agnostic intents, lifecycle, and diagnostics.
long_description: ComfyPilot gives an AI agent a clean tool surface for building, queueing, monitoring, and routing ComfyUI workflows. v1.9.0 is tested from ComfyUI v0.20.0 through v0.31.1 and adds canonical jobs listing/detail/batch cancellation, state-aware single cancellation with legacy fallback, workflow and partial-execution metadata, native /global_subgraphs normalization, localized Markdown node documentation, expanded multi-GPU and deployment capability data, and correct handling for modern V3-derived widgets and node metadata. The family-aware builder covers SD 1.5, SDXL, SD 3.5, Flux 2, Qwen-Image, Wan 2.2, LTX-2, HunyuanVideo, Hunyuan3D, ACE-Step, and Ernie Image, plus 5 family-agnostic intents. Ships 13 bundled subgraph blueprints, a 6-pass validator, VRAM safety, snapshots, output routing, optional OpenAPI 3.1 ingestion, lifecycle, diagnostics, convenience tools, and stdio or streamable-http transport.

comfy_url.title: ComfyUI URL
comfy_url.description: URL of the ComfyUI server. Use http://127.0.0.1:8188 for a local install, https://cloud.comfy.org for Comfy Cloud, or your Tailscale / LAN / port-forwarded address.

comfy_api_key.title: ComfyUI API key
comfy_api_key.description: Optional API key for authenticated ComfyUI instances. Bearer for local, X-API-Key for Comfy Cloud (auto-detected).

comfy_auth_method.title: Auth header style
comfy_auth_method.description: Force a specific auth header style, or leave as auto to let ComfyPilot pick based on the URL. Options: auto, bearer, x-api-key.

comfy_timeout.title: HTTP timeout (seconds)
comfy_timeout.description: Per-request timeout. 300 is plenty for most generations; raise for very slow video models.

comfy_snapshot_limit.title: Max snapshots retained
comfy_snapshot_limit.description: Oldest snapshots are evicted beyond this cap.

comfy_snapshot_dir.title: Snapshot directory (optional)
comfy_snapshot_dir.description: If set, snapshots persist to this directory and survive restarts. If empty, snapshots are in-memory only.

comfy_blueprint_dir.title: Blueprint directory
comfy_blueprint_dir.description: Where user-published subgraph blueprints live. Bundled examples (Flux 2, Wan 2.2, etc.) are always available.

comfy_output_dir.title: Disk output directory
comfy_output_dir.description: Default destination for images routed via comfy_send_to_disk.

comfy_td_output_dir.title: TouchDesigner output directory
comfy_td_output_dir.description: Destination when routing images to a TouchDesigner project.

comfy_blender_output_dir.title: Blender output directory
comfy_blender_output_dir.description: Destination when routing images to a Blender project.

comfy_strict_confirm.title: Strict-confirm destructive ops
comfy_strict_confirm.description: Set to `1` to fail-closed on destructive tools (clear_queue, clear_history, delete_history, delete_snapshot, emergency_stop) when the host lacks elicitation support. Default is fail-open for backward compatibility.
